title: The 5 Deepest Ocean Trenches, Ranked (All 5 Are in One Ocean)

scenes.text: The five deepest trenches on Earth, ranked. All five are hiding in the very same ocean.

scenes.label: Kermadec · 10,040 m
scenes.text: Number five: the Kermadec Trench in the South Pacific. About ten thousand and forty meters down, deeper than Everest is tall.

scenes.label: Kuril-Kamchatka · 10,500 m
scenes.text: Number four: the Kuril-Kamchatka Trench in the northwest Pacific. Around ten thousand five hundred meters deep.

scenes.label: Philippine · 10,540 m
scenes.text: Number three: the Philippine Trench, beneath the Philippine Sea. About ten thousand five hundred and forty meters straight down.

scenes.label: Tonga · 10,880 m
scenes.text: Number two: the Tonga Trench. About ten thousand eight hundred and eighty meters, just a little shy of first place.

scenes.label: Mariana · 10,935 m
scenes.text: Number one: the Mariana Trench, nearly eleven thousand meters deep. And yes, every single trench on this list is in the Pacific.

description:
The five deepest ocean trenches on Earth, ranked by maximum depth.
From the Kermadec Trench to the Mariana Trench, every one of them is in the Pacific Ocean.
Which trench would you explore first?
first_comment: Which trench would you dive to first? And what should we rank next?
